_note: What every car's tree shares (step T1 + the data half of T3, 2026-10-10): tier bands, price factors, the Workshop row and the parts ladder. Prices are GUESSES in nights of play until the in-game economy is worked out (Roy, 2026-10-10). Read by scripts/car/mod_tree.gd.

tiers._note: Power bands in Nm of peak torque (on full boost) per kg, PR #175: a build is in tier Tn when its number is at or over floor[n] and under floor[n+1]. price_factor: price = nights x the car's tier factor (starting values). ceiling_by_car_tier: the highest tier a car's fully fitted build may reach, by the tier the car arrives at.

workshop._note: The Workshop (bolt-on) row: the 26 items of data/bolt_ons/bolt_ons.json, any order, any car. The ECU unlock lives here, not in a car's slots. Only prices are added here; a stepped item is priced per step. All guesses.

ladder._note: Parts ladder, the same on every car. Each part is stock plus three rungs, each rung bought once per car; the fitted id is <part>_<rung> (tyres_2). A rung sets how far the Tuner sliders it covers may move from the car's base build: 'notches' is the half-width in Tuner notches (a notch is a tenth of the slider's safe range), -1 is the whole safe range. Index 0 is stock. A rung's ops move the base (same op format as a tree node). Presets ignore the windows. Paths no part covers (aero, assists, steering lock, brake bias) stay open; boost belongs to the turbo node.

options._note: The Tyres option hook: the tyre rung unlocks compounds, the player fits one (fitted id compound_<id>; none fitted = the best one unlocked). The compound owns tyre friction, so the Tuner has no friction slider on a tree car.

owners._note: Who owns which number. tree: hardware a node sets; saved tunes stop storing these and the Tuner stops showing them when the tree is wired in. ladder: set by a part rung or its option. Everything else in TuneParams stays the Tuner's, inside the windows.
